P.name: Backstab
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Shaco's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} are empowered to deal {{as|{{pp|20 + (35-25)/17*(x-1) for 20}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ 20% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} when hitting an enemy from behind. This damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
P.description2: ''{{ai|Deceive|Shaco}}'' and ''{{ai|Two-Shiv Poison|Shaco}}'' have additional effects when they hit an enemy from behind.

Q.name: Deceive
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Shaco''' becomes {{tip|invisible}} for a duration, and after a {{fd|0.125}}-second delay, he {{tip|blinks}} to the target location.
Q.description2: ''Deceive's'' {{tip|invisibility}} breaks when '''Shaco''' uses a basic attack or casts ''{{ai|Two-Shiv Poison|Shaco}}'', but not from casting ''{{ai|Jack in the Box|Shaco}}'' or ''{{ai|Hallucinate|Shaco}}''.
Q.description3: After breaking the invisibility, '''Shaco''' empowers his next basic attack within {{fd|0.25}} seconds to deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, which is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
Q.description4: {{sbc|{{ai|Backstab|Shaco}} Bonus:}} The attack will {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|160|60}}|critical damage}} damage, increased to {{as|{{critical damage|200|100}}|critical damage}} if a critical strike was {{tt|rolled|See notes}}.

W.name: Jack in the Box
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Shaco''' summons a ''box'' at the target location that becomes {{tip|stealthed trap|stealthed}} after arming over 2 seconds, lasting for up to 40 {{as|(+ 10% AP)}} seconds. The ''box'' is {{tip|invulnerable}} and {{tip|untargetable}} to enemies while stealthed.
W.description2: The ''box'' will spring out upon enemy contact, {{tip|fearing}} nearby enemies for a duration, modified to {{fd|2.2}} seconds against non-champions, and {{tip|root|rooting}} them for a duration, modified to a 1 second root against non-champions. After a {{fd|0.15}}-second delay of the ''box's'' activation, enemies hit also have their {{sti|{{as|movement speed}}}} reduced. Enemy champions have their {{as|movement speed}} set to a {{as|static 100|ms}}, while non-champions are set to a {{as|static 60|ms}}. The {{as|movement speed}} reduction lasts for the same duration as the fear plus {{fd|0.3}} seconds.
W.description3: Once sprung, the ''box'' will remain for 5 seconds, during which it will automatically fire at nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemies every {{fd|0.5}} seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} with each attack. If the ''box'' attacks only one target, it deals increased damage. ''Boxes'' deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} to {{tip|monsters}} and 50% reduced damage to {{tip|turrets|structures}}.
W.leveling3:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|10 to 30}} {{as|(+ 12% AP)}}|Increased Damage|{{ap|25 to 85}} {{as|(+ 18% AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Monster Damage|{{ap|20 to 80}}|Total Monster Damage|{{ap|10+20 to 30+80}} {{as|(+ 12% AP)}}|Increased Monster Damage|{{ap|25+20 to 85+80}} {{as|(+ 18% AP)}}}}

E.name: Two-Shiv Poison
E.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Shaco's''' basic attacks {{tip|slow}} enemies for 2 seconds while ''Two-Shiv Poison'' is not on cooldown.
E.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Shaco''' throws a dagger at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}}, {{ccs|increased by 50%|magic}} if they are {{as|'''below''' 30% of their '''maximum''' health}}, and {{tip|slows}} them for 3 seconds.
E.description3: {{sbc|{{ai|Backstab|Shaco}} Bonus:}} The dagger deals an additional {{as|{{pp|15 + (50-15)/17*(x-1) for 20}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}, increased to {{as|{{pp|15*1.5 + (50*1.5-15*1.5)/17*(x-1) for 20}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*1.5}}% AP)}} if the target is {{as|'''below''' 30% of their '''maximum''' health}}.

R.name: Hallucinate
R.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Shaco''' {{tip|vanish|vanishes}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds and {{tip|blinks}} in the {{tt|target direction|150 units}} while creating a {{tip|clone}} of himself that is summoned in the {{tt|opposite direction|150 units}}, remaining within {{tt|control range|1125 units}} of him as a controllable {{tip|clone}} for up to 18 seconds.

''Hallucinate'' can be recast at any time while the clone is alive, and can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.
R.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Shaco''' commands the {{tip|clone}} to move to the target location.
R.description3: The clone will explode upon dying or expiring to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and deploy three ''{{ai|Jack in the Box|Shaco|mini-boxes}}'' that activate instantly, {{tip|fearing}} nearby enemies for 1 second, increased to {{fd|2.2}} seconds against non-champions, and {{tip|root|rooting}} them for {{fd|0.5}} seconds, increased to {{tt|{{fd|0.6}} seconds|Estimated}} against monsters and {{tt|1 second|Estimated}} against minions. After a {{fd|0.15}}-second delay of the ''boxes' '' activation, enemies hit also have their {{as|movement speed}} reduced. Enemy champions have their {{as|movement speed}} set to a {{as|static 100|ms}}, while non-champions are set to a {{as|static 60|ms}}. The {{as|movement speed}} reduction lasts for the same duration as the fear plus {{fd|0.3}} seconds.
R.description4: The ''boxes'' possess ''{{ais|Jack in the Box|Shaco}}'' effects, except they have a doubled, but shared {{sti|{{as|health}}}}, and deal {{as|'''modified''' magic damage}} with each attack, increased when attacking a single unit. They are also {{tip|invulnerable}} for {{tt|{{fd|0.5}}|estimated}} seconds after deployment.
R.leveling4: {{st|Modified Magic Damage|{{ap|10 to 30}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}}|Increased Modified Damage|{{ap|25 to 75}} {{as|(+ 15% AP)}}}}
